$comment: Hand-edited properties; geometry rebuilt from trace.json by make past (decision 12).

properties.name: Fourth St, Santa Rosa, the depot to McDonald Ave (horsecars)
properties.notes: The court dates this track, "the track on Fourth street", to 1877; Borden opens the line a year after its June 5, 1877 franchise. Its own 3 ft 6 in track, not the Petaluma & Santa Rosa's of 1905 on the same street (Borden; CRC Decision No. 2348, p. 760). Borden's map shows a loop around the courthouse in the square, not drawn; the Union and Central cars ran over this track to the depot (Borden, pp. 3-4). How long the horsecars ran isn't known.
properties.geometry_method: Along today's 4th Street centerline from Wilson Street to McDonald Avenue (1699 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1, across gaps of up to 300 m where the street is cut today); checked on USGS Santa Rosa 1:24,000 (1954). East along Fourth St from the San Francisco & North Pacific depot at Wilson St to McDonald Ave (Borden), across today's freeway and mall, where Overture has no 4th St; the same street as the Petaluma & Santa Rosa's later track.

properties.name: McDonald Ave, Santa Rosa, Fourth St to the cemetery (horsecars)
properties.notes: Built to serve Mark L. McDonald's subdivision, the McDonald Addition (Borden). The court dates only the Fourth St track; Borden has the whole line open in 1878, so this stretch's year isn't sourced on its own.
properties.geometry_method: Along today's McDonald Avenue centerline from 4th Street to Franklin Avenue (925 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); checked on USGS Santa Rosa 1:24,000 (1954) and USGS Santa Rosa 1:62,500 (1916). North on McDonald Ave from Fourth St to the Rural Cemetery's south corner (Borden), where today's Franklin Ave begins; the 1916 and 1954 sheets draw the street to the corner.

properties.name: Petaluma, 12th and F Sts to Washington and Payran Sts (horsecars)
properties.notes: Its streets from Borden, who takes them from a map of 1897. Standard gauge, 2.5 miles with the fairgrounds branch (Borden); 1.81 miles in the census of 1902.
properties.geometry_method: Along today's F Street centerline from 12th Street to 6th Street (739 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); then along today's 6th Street centerline from F Street to Liberty Street (631 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); then along today's Liberty Street centerline from 6th Street to Western Avenue (167 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); then along today's Western Avenue centerline from Liberty Street to Kentucky Street (171 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); then along today's Kentucky Street centerline from Western Avenue to Washington Street (204 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); then along today's Washington Street and East Washington Street centerline from Kentucky Street to Payran Street (1160 m; Overture 2026-09-23.1); checked on USGS Petaluma 1:62,500 (1914) and USGS Petaluma 1:24,000 (1953). From the car barn at 12th and F Sts by F St, 6th St, Liberty St, Western Ave, Kentucky St and Washington St, across Petaluma Creek and the San Francisco & North Pacific, to Payran St (Borden, from a map of 1897). Not drawn: the last stretch to just beyond Mary St, and the branch into the fairgrounds, since no Mary St crosses Washington St today.
